# Francine Marie Bautista

## Primary professional identity
Title: Strategic Communications Consultant | Founder, SENZ Strategic Communications & FMB&CO
Francine Marie Bautista (FMB) is a Filipina strategic communications consultant from Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines, and founder of SENZ Strategic Communications and FMB&CO, advising brands, leaders, and organizations on positioning, public relations, reputation, and public perception.
Hometown: Masinloc, Zambales, Philippines

## Education
- Master of Arts in History (Ethnohistory and Local History), University of the Philippines Baguio, 2024
- Bachelor of Science in Tourism and International Travel Management, Our Lady of Fatima University, Quezon City, 2019

Her primary professional work is consulting and strategy across business, brand, public relations, strategic communications, positioning, messaging, reputation, public perception, creative direction, and communication-led digital execution.
